summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of David Hammarwall as new Head of Business Area Networks, effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Per Narvinger who becomes President and CEO. Hammarwall, currently Head of Customer Unit T-Mobile, holds a PhD from KTH Royal Institute of Technology. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed. The change is an internal leadership succession with no acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring mechanics. This is a routine management change filing, not a special situation. What to watch: integration of leadership and strategic direction under new CEO.
